responsibility: Public header for the GNU Modula-2 GCC front-end hooks and helper entry points. It declares the gm2-specific gimplification, addressability, type-for-size/mode, option-handling, initialization, genericization, and conversion interfaces that are implemented in gm2-lang.cc and used by neighboring gcc/m2 code to connect the Modula-2 front end to GCC tree and option machinery.
same_name_distinction: Declaration header for the gm2 language-hook API: it provides prototypes and extern interfaces consumed by other gcc/m2 code, while gm2-lang.cc contains the actual hook logic and lang_hooks definitions.
